notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Start 7': This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time, Cloud City: Upper Walkway, I'm Sorry, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Crush The Rebellion, Prepared Defenses, plus a '3rd effect depends on opponent' line that names no card (the Effects section marks There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Allegations Of Corruption or Wipe Them Out, All Of Them as the one to start). That line is not counted.
The list as published totals 59 cards; the post's '61 card' extras suggest the author counted the 3rd starting effect twice. Kept as published.

Posted 'TDIGWATT' dested This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time; 'Upper walkway (exterior site)' Cloud City: Upper Walkway; 'Bespin', 'Cloud City', 'Chasm walkway' and 'West gallery' dested the Dark versions; 'CCdocking bay' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay), the Dark Cloud City docking bay.
Posted 'Trooper Davin Felth(white border)' dested the A New Hope Trooper Davin Felth: the post predates the virtual Felth (V), so 'white border' is read as a printing remark.

Posted 'Major Bursk' dested Sergeant Major Bursk; 'Sergeant Major Narthax' dested Sergeant Narthax; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Os-71-1 in Obsidian 1' OS-72-1 In Obsidian 1; 'SFS tie Laser cannon' SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons; 'Chimeara' Chimaera.
Posted 'TINT/OE' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'Ghhk/TRWEU' Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Black sun fleet -AO' the Admiral's Order Black Sun Fleet.
The strategy says the deck went 1st, 2nd, 4th and 1st at four unnamed tournaments in Australia around the release of Reflections III.
